name: Mixcloud

sources.title: Mixcloud sign-up — email signup, 'Upload for free', Pro for creators upsell ($3.08/mo annual)

conditions: Free account can upload shows ('Upload for free') but with limits — unlimited uploads, live streaming without takedowns, and customization require Pro for Creators ($3.08/mo billed annually)
requirements: Content must be audio — shows, mixes, podcasts; Mixcloud is an audio platform, not a product directory
Relevant only if the product can legitimately produce audio content (podcast episode, founder interview, product-adjacent mix)
preparation: An audio file worth publishing (e.g. a podcast episode discussing the product problem space)
Show title, description with the product URL, tags, and artwork
workflow: Sign up at https://www.mixcloud.com/signup/ with email
Go to /upload/ and publish the show with description + link
Public show page lives at mixcloud.com/<profile>/<show-slug>/
watchFor: Free tier has upload limits — the 'Pro for Creators' upsell is prominent throughout signup
Mixcloud licenses music legally; pure spoken/podcast content is fine but this is not a backlink farm — low-quality promo shows will not perform
countsAsLive: A public creator profile and at least one public show page exist on mixcloud.com
unknowns: rel attributes on profile and description links
